description_en: Queries the auto-renewal status of a subscription AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeAutoRenewAttribute接口查询包年包月集群自动续费状态
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-auto-renew-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-ids am-bp11q28kvl6880000 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Separate multiple clusters with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
如果有多个集群ID，以英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

AutoRenewAttribute.description_en: The renewal information of the cluster

AutoRenewEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the cluster. Valid values:

true
false
AutoRenewEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值说明：
true：开启。
false：关闭

PeriodUnit.description_en:
The unit of the renewal duration. Valid values:

Year
Month
PeriodUnit.description_zh:
续费时长单位，取值说明：
Year：年。
Month：月

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the cluster

RenewalStatus.description_en:
The renewal status of the cluster. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: The cluster is automatically renewed.
Normal: The cluster is manually renewed. Before the cluster expires, the system sends you a reminder by SMS message.
NotRenewal: The cluster is not renewed. Three days before the cluster expires, the system sends you a reminder by SMS message to remind you that the cluster is not renewed. However, the system does not send you a reminder when the cluster expires
RenewalStatus.description_zh:
续费状态。取值说明：
AutoRenewal：自动续费。
Normal：手动续费，集群到期前通过短信提醒。
NotRenewal：到期不续费，集群到期前无提醒，只在到期前第三天发送不续费提醒

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
